Amasomo Umwarimu wa AI Gukora utagifite internet Ibyerekeye

Uburezi bwa Kuri bose, ku buntu

Platform yacu ifite AI tutor, amasomo yihariye, kandi ikora ndetse nta internet ufite. Yubatswe mu Rwanda, kubanyarwanda.

SomaBot

AI Tutor w'Ubuvanganzo

Mwaramutse! Ninde mushobora kumbwira icyo ushaka kwiga uyu munsi?

Mwaramutse SomaBot! Nshaka kwiga Imibare y'inguzanyo

Ikora ndetse nta internet ufite

Inyungu za SomaRwanda

AI Tutor w'Igice cy'Ubuvanganzo

Ubufasha bwa AI bushingiye ku icyongereza, Ikinyarwanda, n'izindi ndimi zikoreshwa mu Rwanda, bukora mu buryo bwo kwigana n'abanyeshuri.

Igisubizo cyihariye ku banyeshuri bose :cite[2]:cite[8]

Gukoresha utagira Internet

Koresha SMS, WhatsApp, cyangwa app yo ku mudasobwa utagira interinet kugirango ukomeze kwiga aho uko ari ho hose.

Yemewe ku turere dutagira interinet :cite[6]

Amasomo yihuje n'intego z'Uburezi

Amasomo yose ahuriza hamwe n'intego z'Uburezi mu Rwanda (REB), akaziba igice cy'amasomo y'ishuri.

Igenderewe abanyeshuri kuva P1 kugeza S6 :cite[10]

Amasomo

Inguzanyo: Imibare y'inguzanyo

P5 - S3

Menya uburyo bwo kubara inguzanyo, amafaranga yishyurwa, n'ibindi byose bijyanye n'inguzanyo.

Iminota 45
AI Tutor

Kwandika neza Ikinyarwanda

P3 - P6

Menya uburyo bwo kwandika ibisomwa, impuzandimi, n'imyandikire y'icyongereza mu buryo bworoshye.

Vidiyo 12
SMS

Biologiya: Ubuzima bw'ibimera

S1 - S3

Menya uko ibimera bitera, bihunga, kandi bikora photosynthesis mu buryo bworoshye.

Ibibazo 24

Umwarimu wa AI: SomaBot

Chatbot y'Ubuvanganzo ifasha mu kwiga iby'amasomo yose mu buryo bw'ibiganiro. Ikora ndetse nta internet ufite!

Ibyiza bya SomaBot

  • Igisubizo cyihariye ku banyeshuri bose :cite[2]
  • Ibikoresho by'uburezi binyuze mu ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda :cite[5]
  • Gukora mu buryo bwa SMS, WhatsApp, App, na Web
  • Inyigisho zigezweho mu buryo bwo kwigisha :cite[4]

Kanda hano:

SomaBot

Ubuvanganzo • Ikinyarwanda • Imibare

Mwaramutse! Ninde mushobora kumbwira icyo ushaka kwiga uyu munsi?

Mwaramutse SomaBot! Nshaka kwiga Imibare y'inguzanyo

Ni byiza! Reka tubone inguzanyo y'amafaranga 50,000 FRW, igihembwe cy'amezi 12, isanzwe ishura 12% mu mwaka. Mbwire amafaranga wakwishyura buri kwezi?

Gukora utagifite Internet

SomaRwanda ikora no mu turere dutagira interinet. Koresha uburyo bwa SMS, WhatsApp, cyangwa App yo ku mudasobwa

SMS

Tuma "SOMA" kuri 4567 kugirango ubone amasomo, ibibazo, n'ibisubizo vya SMS.

Ikoreshwa na Telekom, MTN, na Airtel

WhatsApp

Kora na SomaBot binyuze muri WhatsApp ukoresheje +250 796132866.

AI Tutor ikora ku buryo bwa WhatsApp

Kubikura amasomo

Bika amasomo, vidiyo, n'ibibazo ujya ukoresha igihe ufite interinet, uzabisanga uko ari byo byose utagifite interinet.

Ikora ku mudasobwa, Tableti, na Smartphone

Shaka amasomo utagifite Internet?

Tuma "SOMA LIST" kuri 4567 kugirango ubone urutonde rw'amasomo aboneka mu buryo bwa SMS.
